fields.name: site_id
fields.label: Site ID
fields.what: A unique, stable identifier for the site. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.
fields.if_missing: the file is refused

fields.name: site_name
fields.label: Site Name
fields.what: Display name. Not a model input.
fields.if_missing: the site_id is shown instead

fields.name: site_type
fields.label: Site Type
fields.what: What the building is, e.g. library, office, recreation, garage. A type containing 'garage' is routed to fire/AHJ review before any normal buildout.
fields.if_missing: 'unspecified'

fields.name: lat
fields.label: Latitude
fields.what: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees. Projected coordinates are refused, never converted.
fields.if_missing: the map surfaces are unavailable; nothing else changes

fields.name: lon
fields.label: Longitude
fields.what: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees.
fields.if_missing: the map surfaces are unavailable; nothing else changes

fields.name: employees_day
fields.label: Staff per Day
fields.what: Staff on site on a typical day. Drives expected charging sessions, not the score.
fields.if_missing: counts as 0 expected sessions from staff

fields.name: visitors_day
fields.label: Visitors per Day
fields.what: Visitors on a typical day. Drives expected charging sessions, not the score.
fields.if_missing: counts as 0 expected sessions from visitors

fields.name: fleet_vehicles
fields.label: Fleet Vehicles
fields.what: Fleet vehicles based at the site. Read and carried, not used.
fields.if_missing: nothing changes

fields.name: parking_spaces
fields.label: Parking Spaces
fields.what: Parking spaces at the site. Also caps the port plan at 5% of spaces (2 to 12).
fields.if_missing: earns no credit, and the port plan is capped at 2

fields.name: hours_open
fields.label: Hours Open per Day
fields.what: Hours the site is open on a typical day. A '_min' column is recognised and converted.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit; port sizing assumes 8 hours

fields.name: avg_dwell_min
fields.label: Average Visit Length
fields.what: Average length of a visit. An '_hr' or '_sec' column is recognised and converted.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit; port sizing assumes 120 minutes

fields.name: nearby_households_1mi
fields.label: Households Within 1 Mile
fields.what: Households within 1 mile.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: nearby_jobs_1mi
fields.label: Jobs Within 1 Mile
fields.what: Jobs within 1 mile.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: aadt_nearest
fields.label: Daily Traffic Nearby
fields.what: Annual average daily traffic on the nearest arterial.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: amenities_count_0_5mi
fields.label: Amenities Within Half a Mile
fields.what: Amenities (shops, services) within half a mile.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: ev_share_local
fields.label: Local EV Share
fields.what: Share of locally registered vehicles that are electric, as a fraction: 0.03 means 3%.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: existing_l2_ports_1mi
fields.label: Level 2 Ports Within 1 Mile
fields.what: Public Level 2 charging ports already within 1 mile. Lower is better.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: existing_dcfc_ports_3mi
fields.label: DC Fast Ports Within 3 Miles
fields.what: Public DC fast charging ports already within 3 miles. Lower is better.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: equity_gap_index
fields.label: Equity Need
fields.what: Charging-equity need, 0 (least) to 1 (most underserved).
fields.if_missing: earns no credit; the contract's equity_indicator is left empty

fields.name: spare_capacity_kw
fields.label: Spare Electrical Capacity
fields.what: Spare electrical capacity at the service. Used in the score, but the contract reports capacity as a placeholder until a utility or facility confirms it. Watts and megawatts are recognised and converted.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: distance_to_service_ft
fields.label: Distance to Electrical Service
fields.what: Distance from the parking area to the electrical service. Lower is better. Metres are recognised and converted.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: trenching_ft
fields.label: Trenching Needed
fields.what: Trenching needed. Lower is better. Metres are recognised and converted.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit, and the site gets no cost figures

fields.name: trench_cost_per_ft
fields.label: Trenching Cost per Foot
fields.what: Trenching cost per foot.
fields.if_missing: the install-cost term earns no credit, and the site gets no cost figures

fields.name: service_upgrade_cost_usd
fields.label: Service Upgrade Cost
fields.what: Cost of upgrading the electrical service. Lower is better.
fields.if_missing: earns no credit, and the site gets no cost figures

fields.name: elec_service_rating_amp
fields.label: Service Rating
fields.what: Rating of the electrical service. Read and carried, not used.
fields.if_missing: nothing changes

fields.name: public_access
fields.label: Open to the Public
fields.what: Is the site open to the public?
fields.if_missing: treated as not public: demand counts at 65%, the 'Low public-priority' tier, and every port target held to 2

fields.name: ada_layout_possible
fields.label: ADA Layout Possible
fields.what: Can an ADA-accessible charging layout be built?
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: fire_access_ok
fields.label: Fire Access Adequate
fields.what: Is fire-service access adequate?
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: garage_enclosed
fields.label: Enclosed Garage
fields.what: Is the parking an enclosed garage? Yes lowers the safety score.
fields.if_missing: earns no safety credit, and the site is a 'High-review candidate'

fields.name: emergency_disconnect_visible
fields.label: Emergency Disconnect Visible
fields.what: Is an emergency disconnect visible from the charging area?
fields.if_missing: earns no credit in the score

fields.name: stormwater_risk
fields.label: Stormwater Risk
fields.what: Is there a stormwater or flooding risk? Yes lowers the safety score.
fields.if_missing: earns no safety credit

fields.name: battery_storage_flag
fields.label: Battery Storage on Site
fields.what: Is battery storage on site? Read and carried, not used.
fields.if_missing: nothing changes
